post.description:
201 with a new document; 200 with the existing one when these bytes are already in
the vault. 413 past HAUSBUCH_MAX_UPLOAD_BYTES, 415 outside the allow-list.

`ai` (default HAUSBUCH_AI_ENABLED) also queues a pre-fill proposal and answers with a
DocumentUploadResult (the document plus the proposal to poll, §6.1); without it the
answer is the Document, as in phase 1. For bytes already in the vault the document's
latest proposal is returned instead of a new read. `contains_tenant_data` with the
workspace's ai_tenant_documents off stores the proposal blocked, unread (D16).

Record the rejection (an eval signal); no domain writes.

Moving the anchor (opening_balance, opening_balance_on) re-checks every import.

AcquisitionCostKind.description: Anschaffungsnebenkosten. Itemized so the AfA basis is traceable (principle 2).

AppliedEntity.title: AppliedEntity
AppliedEntity.description:
One record of an applied proposal and the entity it created or patched (for a link,
the entity the document was linked to). entity_id is null for a skipped record.

ChecklistDocumentRef.title: ChecklistDocumentRef
ChecklistDocumentRef.description:
A satisfying document, without its title or filename (either can name a tenant, D5):
the frontend labels it by type and date and links to the document.

Currency.title: Currency

transaction.currency. v1 is EUR only (one value, kept as a CHECK'd set like
InvitePurpose).

DateCorrection.title: DateCorrection
DateCorrection.description: Corrects a milestone date: purchase date (Übergang) or move-in.

DeclareBalanceBody.title: DeclareBalanceBody
DeclareBalanceBody.description: POST /imports/{id}/balances: the closing balance Luis reads in online banking.

event; the latest of its chain, should one ever be corrected).

DisbursementCorrection.description:
POST /loans/{id}/corrections/disbursement: the payout date and/or the principal; an
absent (or null) field keeps the recorded value.

Document.title: Document
Document.description: One per file per workspace: re-uploading the same bytes returns this row.

DocumentDetail.title: DocumentDetail
DocumentDetail.description: GET /documents/{id}: one read transaction over the document and its layers.

DocumentExtraction.title: DocumentExtraction
DocumentExtraction.description:
Append-only. A new version is a new row; the highest version is current.

kind (phase 2, migration 0005) says which field set `fields` holds: `manual` is
ManualDocumentFields, every other kind its per-type model in schemas/extraction.py. The
kind is a column, not a key inside the fields, so the union is resolved from it here
rather than by a Pydantic discriminator. ai_call_id is the call an `ai` version came from
(D18); a `manual` version on top of it (Luis edited extracted fields) has none.

DocumentLink.title: DocumentLink
DocumentLink.description: Links a document to exactly one entity (the thing it proves).

DocumentSubtype.title: DocumentSubtype
DocumentSubtype.description: Finer typing where retention or the AfA basis depends on it.

DocumentType.title: DocumentType
DocumentType.description: The classifier's output set (AI layer). Phase 1 sets it by hand.

DocumentTyping.title: DocumentTyping
DocumentTyping.description: What a person (phase 1) or the classifier (phase 2) says the document is.

DocumentUploadResult.title: DocumentUploadResult
DocumentUploadResult.description:
POST /documents with ai = true (§6.1): the document plus the queued proposal to
poll. proposal_id is null when the upload did not ask for a proposal.

EntityType.title: EntityType
EntityType.description: Entities that carry events. Also the prefix of every event type.

ErrorKind.title: ErrorKind
ErrorKind.description: ErrorResponse.error: the stable string the frontend switches on.

ErrorResponse.title: ErrorResponse
ErrorResponse.description: Every non-2xx body. Only the fields that apply to `error` are set (see ErrorKind).

ExtractedValue.title: ExtractedValue
ExtractedValue.description:
One field of a per-type extraction, or of a proposal record.

checks say what code verified: `cited` (the API attached a citation, so `source` is set),
`value_in_quote` (the value is recoverable from the cited text), `validates` (the value
passes the target field's Pydantic type), `derived` (code computed it from the fields in
`derived_from`, e.g. building_share). The confidence is a function of the checks, computed
by rules.extraction_parse (fixture extraction_parse.yaml); this model only enforces that
the checks are consistent with the other fields.

ExtractionKind.title: ExtractionKind
ExtractionKind.description:
document_extraction.kind and proposal.kind (migration 0005): which field set an
extraction holds. `manual` is phase 1's ManualDocumentFields; the others are the per-type
models in schemas/extraction.py.

FieldDecision.title: FieldDecision
FieldDecision.description:
What the user did with one proposed value. Recorded per field on apply, without the
value (proposal.applied event, eval record).

FieldError.title: FieldError
FieldError.description: One validation error, whitelisted to these three keys: never input, ctx or url (§3.6).

Fraction.title: Fraction
Fraction.description: An exact share: ownership (1/2) or Miteigentumsanteil (85/1000).

HausgeldabrechnungExtraction.description: Hausgeldabrechnung: the year's settlement (read by phase 3's Hausgeld rule).

ImportStatus.title: ImportStatus
ImportStatus.description:
statement_import.status. `imported` with no declared closing balance is what the
inbox shows as "pending balance" (reconcile's pending_balance).

InitialRent.title: InitialRent
InitialRent.description: The first rent row, recorded with the tenancy (reason 'initial').

Invite.title: Invite

response, the one time the raw token exists; GET /auth/invites never has it.

InviteCreate.title: InviteCreate

LeaseExtraction.title: LeaseExtraction
LeaseExtraction.description: Mietvertrag (contract / lease). Step 2, gated by ai_tenant_documents (D16).

LinkTarget.title: LinkTarget
LinkTarget.description: What a document can be linked to (document_link has one FK column per target).

LinkTargetRef.title: LinkTargetRef
LinkTargetRef.description: One entity a document is linked to (a document_link row without its own id).

title.description: a short title; never in events (D5)

LoanCreateRequest.title: LoanCreateRequest
LoanCreateRequest.description: POST /loans: LoanCreate plus the contract date (create_loan's signed_on).

LoanTerms.title: LoanTerms
LoanTerms.description: Everything the schedule is computed from. Input to rules.loan_schedule.

ManualDocumentFields.title: ManualDocumentFields
ManualDocumentFields.description: The fields a person types in phase 1. Per-type schemas replace this in phase 2.

Me.title: Me
Me.description: GET /auth/me, and the response of a successful sign-in or enrollment.

Member.title: Member
Member.description:
GET /auth/members: one household member (an app_user of the workspace). has_passkey
is false while an invited member has not enrolled yet. Never a passkey or a session.

Passkey.title: Passkey
Passkey.description: GET /auth/passkeys: one passkey of the signed-in user.

PasskeyVerifyRequest.title: PasskeyVerifyRequest
PasskeyVerifyRequest.description: POST /auth/passkeys/verify: a further passkey for the signed-in user.

PossibleDuplicate.title: PossibleDuplicate
PossibleDuplicate.description:
transaction_id was stored first; other_transaction_id is the later-imported line,
the one `merged` excludes.

PriceSplitCreate.title: PriceSplitCreate
PriceSplitCreate.description: One candidate building/land split. Rows are append-only; the property selects one.

PriceSplitSource.title: PriceSplitSource
PriceSplitSource.description: Where the building/land split of the purchase price comes from.

PropertyOwnership.title: PropertyOwnership
PropertyOwnership.description: Shares per property must sum to exactly 1 (service-layer rule, see fixtures).

PropertyPatch.title: PropertyPatch
PropertyPatch.description: Non-milestone fields only: the purchase dates and price change through corrections.

Proposal.title: Proposal
Proposal.description:
Read shape. kind is null until the document is classified (the row is created
`queued` at upload); records is empty until `ready`, and again after the D19 scrub.

ProposalApplyResult.title: ProposalApplyResult
ProposalApplyResult.description: POST /proposals/{id}/apply: the applied proposal and what each record became.

ProposalRecord.title: ProposalRecord
ProposalRecord.description:
One record the proposal would create or patch.

key: "property", "unit", "cost:notary", "loan", "tenant:1", "tenancy", "rent", "typing",
  "price_split", "ownership", "link:property", "correction:notarized_on", ...
fields: by the *Create / *Patch field name; a nested field is dotted ("address.city").
  Values the apply step supplies itself (the document as Beleg or evidence, the ids of
  records created in the same apply, a split's source) are not fields.
current: the existing record's values of the same fields, when target_id is set.

ProposalRerunBody.title: ProposalRerunBody
ProposalRerunBody.description:
POST /documents/{id}/proposals (optional body): read the document again. The
tenant-data flag is copied from the document's latest proposal; true adds it, false
never removes it (D16).

ProposalStatus.title: ProposalStatus
ProposalStatus.description: proposal.status (§3.1). applied and rejected are decisions; the rest are job states.

ProposalTargetMode.title: ProposalTargetMode
ProposalTargetMode.description: proposal.target_mode: whether the proposal creates new records or patches `targets`.

title.description: a short title; never in events (D5)

purchase_date.description: Übergang von Besitz, Nutzen und Lasten

land_value.description: price share allocated to the land, if stated

unit_label.description: WE Nr. as in the Teilungserklärung, e.g. WE 3

RelatedDocument.title: RelatedDocument
RelatedDocument.description:
GET /properties/{id}/documents and GET /units/{id}/documents: a document linked to the
target or to one of its children (units, tenancies, loans), with every such link.

RentModel.title: RentModel
RentModel.description: How rent changes over time. Term (befristet / unbefristet) is a separate field.

RentRowCorrection.title: RentRowCorrection
RentRowCorrection.description:
POST /rent-schedule/{row_id}/corrections: the correction row's values; an absent field
keeps the wrong row's value (correct_rent_row).

RentScheduleCreate.title: RentScheduleCreate
RentScheduleCreate.description: A dated rent row. Never edited: a wrong row is superseded by a correction row.

RequirementCode.title: RequirementCode
RequirementCode.description: One kind of paperwork the return needs. German labels and hints live in the frontend.

RetentionHold.title: RetentionHold
RetentionHold.description: Why a retain_until date cannot be computed yet.

RetentionResult.title: RetentionResult
RetentionResult.description: Exactly one of retain_until / hold is set. retention_class is null only when untyped.

ScheduleEntry.title: ScheduleEntry
ScheduleEntry.description:
interest = opening_balance * (nominal * (interest_days - follow_up_days)
+ follow_up * follow_up_days) / 360, rounded half-up (principle 2: traceable).

Session.title: Session
Session.description: The current session (Me.session). The cookie token is never part of any response.

SourceRef.title: SourceRef
SourceRef.description:
Where a value came from: the page (1-indexed, page offset of a split PDF already
added) and the cited text, verbatim.

title.description: a short title; never in events (D5)

StatementExtraction.title: StatementExtraction
StatementExtraction.description:
PDF Kontoauszug (§7.1): balances and lines. Every amount is a model reading, so the
reconciliation is the guard; `lines` holds one text per booking line, parsed into
StatementLines by bank.pdf.

TenancyCreateRequest.title: TenancyCreateRequest
TenancyCreateRequest.description: POST /tenancies: TenancyCreate plus the first rent row (create_tenancy's initial_rent).

TenancyPartiesBody.title: TenancyPartiesBody
TenancyPartiesBody.description: PUT /tenancies/{id}/parties: the whole list (exactly one primary; service rule).

TenancyPatch.title: TenancyPatch
TenancyPatch.description:
PATCH /tenancies/{id}: the non-milestone fields. Move-in, move-out, notice and contract
date change through their corrections, the parties through PUT .../parties.

Tenant.title: Tenant
Tenant.description: Read shape. After erasure every personal field is null and erased_at is set.

TimelineEntry.title: TimelineEntry
TimelineEntry.description: One milestone. For a correction chain A → B → C only one entry appears, showing C.

Transaction.title: Transaction
Transaction.description: Read shape. The counterparty IBAN is shown masked only.

valid_from.description: first month the plan applies to

iban.description: the WEG account the Hausgeld is paid to

WirtschaftsplanExtraction.title: WirtschaftsplanExtraction
WirtschaftsplanExtraction.description: Wirtschaftsplan: the monthly Hausgeld split the by_wirtschaftsplan rule reads (§8.1).

Workspace.title: Workspace
Workspace.description: One household. Every other table carries workspace_id and is filtered by RLS.

YearTotals.title: YearTotals
YearTotals.description: Per calendar year of due_on. Interest here is what Anlage V will reconcile against.

title.description: a short title; never in events (D5)

ZinsbescheinigungExtraction.title: ZinsbescheinigungExtraction
ZinsbescheinigungExtraction.description: Zinsbescheinigung: the year's interest, reconciled against the loan schedule.
